div.head: II Eg 1
div.ab: Þæt syndon þonne ærest, þæt Godes cyrican syn rihtes wyrðe.
Þæt synt þonne ærest, þæt Godes cyrican syn ælces ryhtes wyrðe.
Ðæt synd þonne ærest, þæt Godes cirican syn ælces rihtes wyrðe.
Primum est, ut ecclesie Dei recti sui digne sint.
Ðæt synd þonne ærest, þæt Godes cirican syn ælces rihtes wyrðe.
Þæt syndon þonne ærest: þæt Godes cyrican syn rihtes wyrðe.
Nämlich erstens nun, dass Gottes Kirchen (jeder A D) Berechtigung theilhaftig seien.
Namely, first, that God's churches be entitled to (every, A D) right.
This is the first provision, that God's churches shall be entitled to all their prerogatives.
First, namely, that God’s churches are to be entitled to every right,
Accordingly, this is foremost: that the churches of God be guaranteed of their rights.

note.seg: Ohne ælces der Rec. II wäre riht (s. d. Wb 14) zu farblos
Without the ælces of Rec. II, riht (see that word in Wb 14) would be too colourless
